fusions.name: Envenomed Quiver
fusions.desc: Looses an arrow that deals 8 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Tripwire Spread
fusions.desc: Looses 3 arrows trailing lines in a spread out to 7 tiles. Each deals 8 damage, stuns its target for 1 second and leaves it [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Strung Across the Path
fusions.desc: Strings a taut line 5 tiles long for 8 seconds. Nothing crosses it, and anything that touches it moves 25% slower for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Fang and Broadhead
fusions.desc: Your piercing damage cannot be resisted.
